fichas.title: Library user workstations and table spacing
fichas.summary: Diagrams show a single library-user workplace, spacing between tables, and a formula for estimating the floor area required for an open workstation, including an allowance for adjacent aisles. The printed example states an approximate area of 2.50 m² and gives a worked result of 2.48 m².

fichas.title: Library shelving systems and shelf dimensions
fichas.summary: Text describes freestanding double shelf units, adjustable shelves, mobile shelving for closed stacks, book capacity, and structural floor-load requirements. Diagrams show shelf heights for adults and children, bookcase shelf counts, and a magazine rack. The text states that mobile units can increase capacity by up to approximately 100% under suitable conditions.
